items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: So I'd always ask for Shad.

ctx.x: Did Ike Quebec and Sam the Man sort of do any battling, you know, like Basie's two tenors, or --

I think on one number there. They weren't featured too much, but I think they had one number. But there was an argument down there too, because they would come to me and tell me, because Cab a lot of the time would come to me and say, "We're going to enlarge the band again. So who do you think," you know? So I'd always ask for Shad. A lot of guys didn't like Shad, because Shad would keep you upset. See, he was one of them kind of guys, he wouldn't speak all day. He'd come in and he wouldn't say a word, you know,…

time?" Evil, you know. Oh, don't pay him no mind. He'd come in in the morning, go up there and sit down and never say a word, you know. Go out, eat, come back, second show, not a word, third show, not a word, fourth show -- by the middle of the fourth show he'd say, "Let's hang out tonight."
